metadata.title: SolidWorks CAD Evaluation Operations — Geometry analysis + verification + sustainability layer
metadata.description: Parameter catalog for the SolidWorks CAD evaluation / verification / sustainability layer. Final 8th module in the SolidWorks CAD function-index track. Covers basic measurement (MEASURE / MASS_PROPERTIES / SECTION_PROPERTIES), assembly verification (INTERFERENCE_DETECTION_PART_LEVEL / CLEARANCE_VERIFICATION_PART_LEVEL / COLLISION_DETECTION), part-quality analyses (DRAFT_ANALYSIS / UNDERCUT_ANALYSIS / DEVIATION_ANALYSIS / THICKNESS_ANALYSIS / SYMMETRY_CHECK / ZEBRA_STRIPES / CURVATURE), DESIGN_CHECKER + DFM_CHECKER quality gates, PERFORMANCE_EVALUATION (large-assembly profiling), COSTING (manufacturing cost estimation), SUSTAINABILITY (life-cycle assessment), and PARAMETRIC_LINK_CHECK (external reference health). 18 operations / 145 parameters total. Bindings target IModelDocExtension.GetMeasureManager / IMassProperty / ISectionProperty / IInterferenceDetectionMgr / IClearanceVerification / ICollisionDetectionMgr / IDraftAnalysis / IUndercutAnalysis / IDeviationAnalysis / IThickAnalysis / IDesignChecker / ICostingManager / ISustainabilityManager — the canonical SolidWorks 2024 evaluation API surface.
metadata.source: SolidWorks 2024 API Help — Evaluation; SolidWorks API Reference — IModelDocExtension (measure / mass / section) / IInterferenceDetectionMgr / IClearanceVerification / IDraftAnalysis / IUndercutAnalysis / IDeviationAnalysis / IThickAnalysis / IDesignChecker / ICostingManager / ISustainabilityManager; SolidWorks 2024 Evaluate toolbar; ISO 14040 (life-cycle assessment); ISO 1101 (geometric tolerancing terminology)

commonTabs.description: Standard parameter tabs across SolidWorks evaluation operations

MEASURE.description: Basic geometric measurement between selected entities. Measure Type selects auto-detect (smart-pick from selection topology) or specific (length / angle / radius / arc-length / distance-between-faces). Units control output unit override (otherwise inherits document units).

parameters.name: Entities
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of vertices / edges / faces / points

parameters.name: Project To Plane
parameters.description: Optional projection plane for distance measurements

parameters.name: Use Center To Center
parameters.description: Auto-resolve hole/cylinder selections to centerlines

parameters.name: Save Result To Property
parameters.description: Optional custom property name to receive result

MASS_PROPERTIES.description: Compute mass properties — mass, volume, surface area, density, center of mass, principal axes of inertia, moment of inertia tensor (about COM and about output coordinate system). Override Material Density allows what-if mass with hypothetical material.

parameters.name: Bodies / Components
parameters.description: Comma-separated list, or 'all' for entire model

parameters.name: Reference Coordinate System
parameters.description: Coordinate system for output (default: model origin)

parameters.name: Custom Density
parameters.description: Required when Override Material Density = true

parameters.name: Save Report To Path
parameters.description: Optional .txt report output

SECTION_PROPERTIES.description: Compute 2D section properties — area, perimeter, centroid, moments of inertia, polar moment of inertia, radius of gyration, principal axes — for one or more planar sections. Used for structural analysis and beam-section verification.

parameters.name: Planar Faces
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of planar faces / sketches

parameters.name: Reference Coordinate System
parameters.description: Coordinate system for principal-axis output

INTERFERENCE_DETECTION_PART_LEVEL.description: Multi-body part interference detection — find overlapping volumes between selected bodies of a multi-body part. Distinct from the assembly_operations INTERFERENCE_DETECTION (which scans assembly components); this op operates within a single .sldprt with multiple bodies.

parameters.name: Bodies To Check
parameters.description: Comma-separated, or 'all'

CLEARANCE_VERIFICATION_PART_LEVEL.description: Verify minimum clearance between bodies in a multi-body part. Reports each pair whose closest-point distance falls below the threshold. Counterpart to assembly-level CLEARANCE_VERIFICATION but at part-body granularity.

COLLISION_DETECTION.description: Real-time collision detection during component dragging in an assembly. Sensitivity controls how close components can approach before flagging. Stop On Collision freezes drag motion at first contact (vs continuing to log multiple collisions).

parameters.name: Components To Watch
parameters.description: Comma-separated, or 'all_components'

DRAFT_ANALYSIS.description: Color-map of draft angle relative to a pull direction. Used to verify mold-friendliness — surfaces below the minimum draft cannot be ejected without die damage. Color Bands segment the spectrum into per-band thresholds.

parameters.name: Pull Direction
parameters.description: Plane / face / axis defining mold opening direction

parameters.name: Edge Highlighting
parameters.description: Highlight transition edges between draft regions

UNDERCUT_ANALYSIS.description: Identify undercuts that would prevent mold release along a pull direction. Reports occluded regions of the model surface that would lock against the mold half. Distinct from draft analysis: draft is angular, undercut is topological visibility.

parameters.name: Show Occluded Undercut
parameters.description: Self-occluded faces (not visible from either side)

parameters.name: Show Straddle Faces
parameters.description: Faces visible from both directions

DEVIATION_ANALYSIS.description: Compute deviation between two surfaces (typically: original CAD vs reverse-engineered scan, or pre-deformation vs post-deformation FEA). Outputs RMS / max / min / per-vertex deviation as a color map.

parameters.name: Maximum Deviation
parameters.description: Threshold for color-map saturation

THICKNESS_ANALYSIS.description: Wall-thickness color map across the part. Reports thin walls (below Minimum Thickness threshold) and thick walls (above Maximum Thickness threshold) — critical for injection molding and casting feasibility.

parameters.name: Color Map Range
parameters.description: Range string e.g. '0..5 mm'

SYMMETRY_CHECK.description: Verify model symmetry about a plane / axis / point. Reports asymmetry magnitude (max distance / mean distance / asymmetric face count). Used as an inspection / QA gate before part release.

parameters.name: Symmetry Reference
parameters.description: Plane / axis / point

parameters.name: Rotational Order
parameters.description: Required when Symmetry Type = rotational_axis (e.g. 4 for 4-fold)

ZEBRA_STRIPES.description: Surface continuity visualization via projected zebra stripes. Stripe alignment / smoothness across surface boundaries reveals C0 / C1 / C2 continuity defects. Stripe density and direction control visualization fidelity.

CURVATURE_ANALYSIS.description: Color-mapped Gaussian / mean / principal / absolute curvature visualization. Used to detect surface continuity flaws not visible to zebra stripes (low-amplitude flat-ish defects) and to validate manufacturability of molded surfaces.

DESIGN_CHECKER.description: Run a SolidWorks Design Checker rule-based audit against drafting / modeling standards. Standards Path resolves to a .swstd file (created in the SWDesign Checker app). Auto-Fix attempts non-destructive corrections of failed rules.

parameters.name: Standards Path
parameters.description: Path to .swstd standards file

parameters.name: Check Categories
parameters.description: Comma-separated subset, or 'all'

parameters.name: Block Save On Failure
parameters.description: Reject document save if critical-rule failures exist

DFM_CHECKER.description: DFMXpress design-for-manufacturing audit — checks part geometry against fabrication-process rules (machining / sheet metal / casting / molding). Process Selection scopes the rule set; Aggressiveness governs how strict the cutoff thresholds are.

parameters.name: Custom Rule Set Path
parameters.description: Optional path to custom DFM .xml rule file

parameters.name: Material Override
parameters.description: Optional material name for rule scoping

PERFORMANCE_EVALUATION.description: Profile rebuild / open / save performance for the active document. Reports per-feature rebuild time, total feature count, mate solver time, graphics tessellation cost, and recommendations (lightweight conversion, design-table simplification, suppression candidates).

parameters.name: Repeat Count
parameters.description: Number of profiling runs to average

COSTING.description: Manufacturing cost estimation per the SolidWorks Costing tool. Costing Template selects machining / sheet metal / mold / cast process database. Computes raw stock cost + setup time + machine time + tool cost + labor + overhead + margin.

parameters.name: Template Path
parameters.description: Path to .sldcostt template (overrides built-in)

parameters.name: Material Override
parameters.description: Optional material name override

parameters.name: Custom Operations
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of additional manual operations

parameters.name: Margin Percent
parameters.description: Used when Include Margin Markup = true

SUSTAINABILITY.description: ISO 14040 life-cycle assessment via SolidWorks Sustainability — computes carbon footprint, total energy, air acidification, water eutrophication for the part across the manufacturing -> use -> end-of-life cycle. Region / energy mix scopes electricity carbon intensity.

parameters.name: Recyclable Content Percent
parameters.description: Fraction of material from recycled stock

parameters.name: Transportation Distance
parameters.description: Optional manufacturer-to-use transport distance

parameters.name: Use Phase Energy
parameters.description: Optional use-phase energy consumption

PARAMETRIC_LINK_CHECK.description: Audit external references — out-of-context parametric links to other parts / assemblies, broken design-table references, missing material library references, missing texture / decal references. Critical pre-release gate to ensure model portability.
